style.name: Russian Lubok
style.description: Style Atlas daily pick: a contemporary editorial interpretation of Russian Lubok using bold woodcut-like outlines, flat vermilion, ochre, indigo and green, hand-printed texture, narrative panels and clear modern infographic hierarchy, without copying a specific historical work or living artist.

zh-CN.headlineFact: 规则、健康、气候与记忆汇入同一天
zh-CN.headlineView: 全球系统进入执行与承载力测试
zh-CN.headlineFull: 规则、健康、气候与记忆汇入同一天；全球系统进入执行与承载力测试
zh-CN.intro: 欧盟小包关税、AI透明、单人创业、原住民健康、法国热浪、星空节、艺穗节与长崎和平纪念同时进入行动窗口。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 真正的热点不是声音最大，而是今天必须改变预算、流程与责任。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 世界的九条线，今天都要落到行动上。

en-US.headlineFact: Rules, health, climate and memory converge today
en-US.headlineView: global systems face execution and capacity tests
en-US.headlineFull: Rules, health, climate and memory converge today; global systems face execution and capacity tests
en-US.intro: EU parcel duties, AI transparency, solo entrepreneurship, Indigenous health, France's heatwave, public astronomy, Edinburgh culture and Nagasaki remembrance enter action windows together.
en-US.xiaziQuote: The real hotspot is what changes budgets, processes and accountability today.
en-US.doudouQuote: Nine global threads all have to land in action today.

sources.title: Guidance and legal text on temporary flat fee on low-value imports
International Day of the World's Indigenous Peoples

zh-CN.headlineFact: 欧盟低值小包每类商品征收3欧元
zh-CN.headlineView: 卖家必须重算SKU与到岸成本
zh-CN.headlineFull: 欧盟低值小包每类商品征收3欧元；卖家必须重算SKU与到岸成本
zh-CN.intro: 自7月1日起，低于150欧元的小包按不同关税子目每类征收3欧元；IOSS、HS分类、组合装与DDP报价都需复核。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 小额固定费最容易吞掉低客单和多品类订单的利润。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 一只包裹装三类货，成本就可能敲三次门。

en-US.headlineFact: EU charges EUR3 per category in low-value parcels
en-US.headlineView: sellers must recalculate SKUs and landed cost
en-US.headlineFull: EU charges EUR3 per category in low-value parcels; sellers must recalculate SKUs and landed cost
en-US.intro: Since July 1, parcels under EUR150 face a EUR3 duty for each different tariff category; IOSS, HS classification, bundles and DDP pricing all need review.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Small flat fees can erase margins fastest on low-ticket, multi-category orders.
en-US.doudouQuote: Put three categories in one parcel and cost may knock three times.

sources.title: Guidance and legal text on temporary flat fee on low-value imports

zh-CN.headlineFact: 欧盟AI透明义务实施满一周
zh-CN.headlineView: 标记与披露成为产品能力
zh-CN.headlineFull: 欧盟AI透明义务实施满一周；标记与披露成为产品能力
zh-CN.intro: 自8月2日起，部分AI交互与生成或操纵内容需明确告知、机器可读标记、来源记录和披露责任。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 透明不是最后补水印，而是界面、输出管线和审计共同承担。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 先把来源讲清楚，再让内容跑得更远。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：人工智能 AI。

en-US.headlineFact: EU AI transparency completes its first week
en-US.headlineView: marking and disclosure become product capabilities
en-US.headlineFull: EU AI transparency completes its first week; marking and disclosure become product capabilities
en-US.intro: Since August 2, certain AI interactions and generated or manipulated content require clear notice, machine-readable marking and provenance records.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Transparency is not a final watermark; interfaces, output pipelines and audits must share it.
en-US.doudouQuote: Explain the source before sending content farther.

sources.title: Commission publishes guidelines on transparency obligations for providers and deployers of certain AI systems

zh-CN.headlineFact: AI让单人创业更容易入场
zh-CN.headlineView: 头部成果仍偏向团队复利
zh-CN.headlineFull: AI让单人创业更容易入场；头部成果仍偏向团队复利
zh-CN.intro: 对超过16万款Product Hunt产品的研究显示，生成式AI提高单人创业进入率，但高排名结果仍更多来自团队。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: AI降低做出来的门槛，却没有取消判断、分销与协作的复利。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 一个人更容易开场，冲到前排仍要会借力。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：一人公司 OPC。

en-US.headlineView: top outcomes still favor team compounding
en-US.headlineFull: AI makes solo entry easier; top outcomes still favor team compounding
en-US.intro: Research covering more than 160,000 Product Hunt launches finds generative AI increased solo entry, while teams remained more common among top-ranked outcomes.
en-US.xiaziQuote: AI lowers the making threshold but does not erase the compounding value of judgment, distribution and collaboration.
en-US.doudouQuote: One person can start faster; reaching the front still takes leverage.

sources.title: Generative AI Fuels Solo Entrepreneurship, but Teams Still Lead at the Top

zh-CN.headlineFact: 世界原住民日聚焦原住民助产士
zh-CN.headlineView: 知识、照护与文化需要同等承认
zh-CN.headlineFull: 世界原住民日聚焦原住民助产士；知识、照护与文化需要同等承认
zh-CN.intro: 2026主题强调原住民助产士在生命照护、知识传承、文化身份、适宜医疗和社区福祉中的作用。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 尊重知识体系，要让权利、资源与服务一起到位。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 守护新生命，也是在守护一条文化记忆。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：原住民健康。

en-US.headlineFact: Indigenous Peoples Day honors Indigenous midwives
en-US.headlineView: knowledge, care and culture need equal recognition
en-US.headlineFull: Indigenous Peoples Day honors Indigenous midwives; knowledge, care and culture need equal recognition
en-US.intro: The 2026 theme highlights Indigenous midwives' roles in safeguarding life, transmitting knowledge, strengthening cultural identity and supporting appropriate care.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Respecting knowledge systems means aligning rights, resources and services.
en-US.doudouQuote: Protecting new life also protects a line of cultural memory.

sources.title: International Day of the World's Indigenous Peoples

zh-CN.headlineFact: 法国第三轮热浪继续扩展
zh-CN.headlineView: 35至40摄氏度高温逼近更多地区
zh-CN.headlineFull: 法国第三轮热浪继续扩展；35至40摄氏度高温逼近更多地区
zh-CN.intro: 持续高温向法国北部、东部和东南部延伸，能源、健康、农业、交通与城市公共服务继续承压。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 热浪不是一次天气插曲，而是基础设施与预算的长期变量。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 温度计没下班，城市系统也不能松口气。

en-US.headlineFull: France's third heatwave keeps expanding; 35 to 40C heat approaches more regions
en-US.intro: Persistent heat is spreading toward northern, eastern and southeastern France, keeping pressure on energy, health, agriculture and city services.
en-US.xiaziQuote: A heatwave is not a weather interlude; it is a long-term infrastructure and budget variable.
en-US.doudouQuote: The thermometer is still working, so city systems cannot relax.

sources.title: Summer 2026: understanding the season's weather phenomena

zh-CN.headlineFact: 法国星空之夜迎来收官
zh-CN.headlineView: 500多场活动为8月12日日食倒计时
zh-CN.headlineFull: 法国星空之夜迎来收官；500多场活动为8月12日日食倒计时
zh-CN.intro: 8月7日至9日，约350个团体组织500多场公众活动，主题聚焦太阳、英仙座流星雨与安全观测。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 科学传播最有效的时刻，是让好奇心找到安全、清楚的入口。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 先戴好观测镜，再和太阳赴约。

en-US.headlineFact: France's Nights of the Stars reaches its finale
en-US.headlineView: 500-plus events count down to the August 12 eclipse
en-US.headlineFull: France's Nights of the Stars reaches its finale; 500-plus events count down to the August 12 eclipse
en-US.intro: From August 7 to 9, about 350 groups are staging more than 500 public events focused on the Sun, Perseids and safe observing.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Science communication works best when curiosity finds a safe, clear entrance.
en-US.doudouQuote: Put on safe viewing glasses before meeting the Sun.

zh-CN.headlineFact: 爱丁堡艺穗节首个周末升温
zh-CN.headlineFull: 爱丁堡艺穗节首个周末升温；3649场节目考验城市承载力
zh-CN.intro: 2026艺穗节覆盖258个场地、来自71个国家，共53884场演出，票务、交通、住宿与独立创作者同步高负荷。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 文化节的价值，也在城市如何承接密集创造力。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 舞台越多，后台协作越像一场大演出。

en-US.headlineFact: Edinburgh Fringe's first weekend gathers pace
en-US.headlineFull: Edinburgh Fringe's first weekend gathers pace; 3,649 shows test city capacity
en-US.intro: The 2026 Fringe spans 258 venues, 71 countries and 53,884 performances, pushing ticketing, transport, lodging and independent creators into high-load operation.
en-US.xiaziQuote: A festival's value also lies in how a city carries concentrated creativity.
en-US.doudouQuote: More stages make backstage coordination a performance of its own.

sources.title: The 2026 Edinburgh Festival Fringe programme is now live

zh-CN.headlineView: 11时02分提醒世界核风险仍未退出历史
zh-CN.headlineFull: 长崎纪念原爆81周年；11时02分提醒世界核风险仍未退出历史
zh-CN.intro: 8月9日和平祈念式典悼念受难者，并把和平承诺带入当代核裁军、国际安全与代际教育讨论。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 纪念不是停留在过去，而是让今天的选择避免重复灾难。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 钟声只响一刻，责任要留得更久。

en-US.headlineFact: Nagasaki marks 81 years since the atomic bombing
en-US.headlineView: 11:02 reminds the world that nuclear risk remains
en-US.headlineFull: Nagasaki marks 81 years since the atomic bombing; 11:02 reminds the world that nuclear risk remains
en-US.intro: The August 9 peace ceremony mourns victims and carries commitments to peace into today's nuclear disarmament and security debate.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Remembrance does not stay in the past; it guides choices that prevent repetition.
en-US.doudouQuote: The bell rings for a moment, but responsibility must last longer.
